description: Resume an interrupted asynchronous money operation with its original encrypted arguments and idempotency key. When a prior send may have happened, confirm_reconciled:true is required.

confirm_reconciled.description: Set true only after reconciling balances/hashes when the status reports money_moved true or unknown.

operation_id.description: Operation id returned by start_fund_market, start_bring_home, or submit_arc_transfer.

name: resume_money_operation
